title: JMF Asesores Custom PHP Framework
summary: Architected a custom lightweight PHP framework and normalized SQL analytics pipeline to process complex multi-part survey datasets.
impact: 300% improvement in survey data collection and processing efficiency.
problem: Off-the-shelf survey tools bottlenecked custom validation rules, relational reporting, and automated client exports.
solution: Built a modular PHP request/model layer paired with indexed SQL schemas, stored procedures, and batch report queries.

title: Inventory & Ops Automation Suite
summary: Python scripting suite automating stock reconciliation, SKU discrepancy audits, and batch operational reporting.
impact: Eliminated repetitive manual spreadsheet reconciliation and boosted team throughput.
problem: Manual inventory updates across fragmented exports introduced errors and delayed operational decisions.
solution: Created deterministic Python scripts with validation guards, normalized CSV/JSON transforms, and structured audit logs.

title: Volunteer Logistics & Web Redesign
summary: Led operational logistics for 500+ volunteers alongside a responsive, accessibility-focused company web redesign.
impact: Coordinated 500+ volunteers and grew digital presence by 60%.
problem: Outdated web touchpoints and uncoordinated supply scheduling slowed onboarding and partner visibility.
solution: Redesigned key information architecture for mobile-first clarity and aligned field logistics workflows with digital tracking.
